access_notes: Viewed 2026-11-07 (dress research for the 1812 scene). Oil portrait of two Baltimore children. The boy, perhaps six, in a dark blue jacket and long trousers buttoned together (a skeleton-type suit, buttons at the waist), a wide frilled white collar, white stockings and black shoes; the girl, perhaps three, in a white high-waisted short-sleeved frock to the ankle, a coral necklace and red shoes.
note: Entered for the 1812 children's dress (T-3465; docs/RESEARCH/people-1812-dress/children.md) from the dress research of docs/RESEARCH/people-1812-3461/dress.json; not a Chicago or Fort Dearborn record.
what_it_supplies: a boy's skeleton-type suit with frilled collar and a small girl's white frock about 1805
what_it_does_not_supply: a frontier family; these are Baltimore children painted in their best
